subject.title: [Feature]: Skill author-defined setup hook (run skill-supplied script on install/update)

question: Should OpenClaw support automatic skill-authored setup execution after install/update, and if so should that be a core lifecycle hook or an external ClawHub/admin-plugin workflow backed by SDK helpers?
rationale: Source inspection proves the missing surface, but automation cannot choose the trust boundary for running third-party skill scripts with environment values during install/update.

options.title: Sponsor core lifecycle hook
options.body: Add a narrow `setup.script` contract in core that covers metadata parsing, ClawHub/upload/dependency install and update paths, isolated env handling, consent, timeout, logging/redaction, rollback semantics, docs, and tests.

options.title: Adopt external admin plugin path
options.body: Declare the published ClawHub plugin plus stable SDK helpers as the supported approach and explicitly decline automatic install/update execution for now.

options.title: Defer until SDK settles
options.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/81913 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/81921 define the installed-skill helper and env/path contracts needed by external plugins.

recommendation.title: Sponsor core lifecycle hook
recommendation.body: Add a narrow `setup.script` contract in core that covers metadata parsing, ClawHub/upload/dependency install and update paths, isolated env handling, consent, timeout, logging/redaction, rollback semantics, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest visible history across ClawHub skill install flows, skill install security, and Plugin SDK skills-runtime surfaces touched by this product/security decision.
